content:
Anita: Short follow-up from today's postmortem. We need owners for the remediation buckets: quota/backstop, scheduler tuning, headroom modelling, and recurring-pattern alerts. Please claim.

Raj: I can take quota/backstop. Plan: temporary namespace burst credits + permanent quota uplift request for critical services. Will open PR by Thu 11:00 PT.

Mei: I'll handle scheduler tuning and canary. I'll try changing pod spread constraints and eviction grace. Staging canary Wed 22:30 PT; prod window Thu 02:30 PT if good.

Sam: I'll run headroom sims. Replaying 6 weeks of traffic with spikes, will produce a recommendation and a heatmap. ETA next Tue EOD.

Anita: Good. Add a metric alert for repeated autoscaler throttles (3+ in 10m) and a composite alert for cache-miss + scale-out burst.

Sam: I'll add the composite detection to the sims output so we can tune thresholds.

Raj: For burst-credit policy, suggest gating by customer_tier and job_class; large-context jobs get no burst. I'll include a policy matrix in the PR.

Mei: Kube snippet I'll test in staging:
```
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: model-worker-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
```
And will test `kubectl drain --grace-period=90`.

infra-bot: Created tracker INC-4720: "gpu-autoscale-remediation-owners" assigned to Raj, Mei, Sam. Link: https://tracker.internal/INC-4720. Weekly reminder Mon 09:00 PT.

Anita: Please post progress to INC-4720 and ping this thread for blockers. We'll run the first status sync next Monday. Thanks.

Raj: Noted. PR target Thu 11:00 PT.

Mei: Staging canary scheduled. Will post results.

Sam: Starting sim runs today; will post interim results in tracker.

Anita: Closing loop for now. :thumbsup:
